items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Babs said, well, you mind giving me a light, please? ... Babs said before we went, say, look, let's stop by 25.

ctx.x: Spell. Spell. Spell. Spell. So the boss said, all right. Now I say, babe, I say, babe, you live uptown. I say, you know direct where we can go to this house this morning? Yeah, babe, sure, sure. So I say, all right, I'll leave you off. So I say, all right, you all get off. The hall was packed too. You all get off. The hall was packed too. So you all get off at three o'clock. You get off at three o'clock. Babs said, well, you mind giving me a light, please? I don't know. Thank you. Thank you. What do you mean,…
And he liked it to gamble too.
